raw.query: WITH p50 AS (SELECT d.run_id, c.denominator_kind, c.cost_ratio FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio c ON c.run_id = d.run_id AND c.is_current = true WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.quantile = 'p50' AND c.denominator_kind = 'deployable_static_c8'), sla AS (SELECT DISTINCT i.run_id, i.is_violation FROM provenance.v_infraction i WHERE i.is_current = true AND i.quantile = 'p50') SELECT COUNT(*) AS p50_cost_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ROUND(p.cost_ratio::numeric, 2) = 0.25) AS rows_rounding_to_0_25, MIN(p.cost_ratio) AS min_cost_ratio, MAX(p.cost_ratio) AS max_cost_ratio, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_violation) AS violating_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE s.is_violation = false) AS nonviolating_rows FROM p50 p LEFT JOIN sla s ON s.run_id = p.run_id
raw.observed: 10 current p50 cost rows; 0 round to 0.25x; ratios range from 0.125x to 1.2636109690277972x; 8 violate SLA and 2 do not
raw.evidence: The required ratio view contains no current p50 row rounding to 0.25x, and p50 does not uniformly fail SLA.
raw.fix: Identify a specific p50 run and report its v_cost_ratio value and SLA result; otherwise remove the 0.25x figure and qualify that only 8 of 10 matched rows violate SLA.
